snippet.title: Steamboat Willie: Rescue Mission - OUT NOW ON STEAM! (Retro Platformer)
snippet.description:
Join Willie in a classic 8-bit inspired adventure! Steamboat Willie: Rescue Mission is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam for Windows and Mac! https://ajdesignclassics.com/

Explore 20 challenging levels in this retro-inspired platformer. From the Frozen Woods to the Desert Mines and the Jungle Rhythm, you’ll need to help Willie dodge Pete, collect music notes, and fly his trusty plane to save Winnie!

GET IT ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4567530/Steamboat_Willie_Rescue_Mission/

Features:
• 20 Challenging 8-bit inspired Levels
• Classic Platforming, Climbing, and Flying Gameplay
• Intense Boss Battles against Captain Pete
• Explore diverse worlds: Forests, Deserts, Jungles, and Haunted Houses
• Play as Winnie (Unlockable Secret Mode!)
• Full Gamepad & Controller Support

Available on: Windows PC,  Mac, Android (Coming Soon!)

Learn more at:
https://ajdesignclassics.com/

#SteamboatWillie #8Bit #RetroGaming #Platformer
